name: Eleni Papadopoulos
bio:
Eleni's journey into motorsport logistics began unexpectedly after volunteering at a local rally event in Greece. Captivated by the organized chaos and the sheer scale of moving equipment across challenging terrains, she pursued formal training in supply chain management, specializing in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments. Prior to joining RFK Racing, Eleni honed her skills coordinating logistics for a European GT team, ensuring the seamless transportation of cars, parts, and personnel across the continent. 

Eleni's approach to logistics is characterized by meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving. She believes in anticipating potential disruptions and developing contingency plans to keep the team on schedule. Her distinctive talent lies in her ability to foster strong relationships with suppliers and transport providers, ensuring preferential treatment and reliable service, even under tight deadlines. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to supporting the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleni is of average height with a strong, athletic build, reflecting her active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn worry beads (komboloi) that she occasionally clicks to relieve stress.
Insists on organizing all equipment crates and containers according to a specific color-coded system.
Has a surprising knack for remembering obscure racing regulations and trivia.
